WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval AS health_status,
    CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(sc.spanmin AS REAL), 0) AS rate,
    sc.scancount AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS si
    ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(sc.spanmin AS REAL) <> 0
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT health_status, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(scan_count) AS avg_count
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY health_status
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_averages
), above_average AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_rate, sa.avg_count, oa.all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE oa.all_status_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.avg_rate > oa.all_status_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(avg_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM above_average;
